what: Claims this repository published and then withdrew. Read by research_grade.py: a withdrawn wording may appear anywhere only if its id is cited within `window` lines. Empty until 2026-11-09, when three were recorded: SE-R1 (exp5/exp6's failure shape, superseded by exp7's bug fix), SE-R2 (a bar for every experiment) and SE-R3 (what sets the ~1.9x ratio).

retractions.claim: That exp5/exp6's three designs failed the same way: a dead third neuron that never gets the early wins it needs, so one pattern stays unclaimed.
verbatim: a "dead" third neuron that never gets the early wins it needs, so one pattern stays unclaimed
retractions.truth: One seed (5) on code that kept both STDP Synapses in a list, so Brian2's magic run() dropped noise->out (warned on every run). Built explicitly (exp7), every neuron fires and one neuron per pattern holds on most of seeds 1-8; the failure is the 2x weight-separation bar, unmet on all eight (about 1.5-1.9x).

retractions.claim: That every experiment here had its pass/fail bar declared before it ran.
verbatim: Each one was written with its **pass/fail bar declared before it ran**
with the pass/fail bar declared before each run
retractions.truth: exp1 and exp2 declare no bar; they are demonstrations. exp3 and exp5-exp12 each declare one.

retractions.claim: That the ~1.9x shared by three inhibition topologies was a ceiling on learning, so the next change belonged in the plasticity rule (the LTP threshold).
verbatim:
The one named redesign still unrun is the LTP threshold / lower background rate -- a change to
the PLASTICITY rule, which is where the three converging results now point.
retractions.truth: What sets the ratio (plasticity; multiplicative normalisation cannot change it) still holds. What it measures does not: exp14-17 show the score is 1.07 at t = 0 before any learning, its rise is in the burst synapses, and its denominator (inputs 60-99) holds burst synapses that never fire. Within inputs 0-59 the groups are learned: burst-synapse selectivity passed a pre-registered test on new seeds 9-16 (exp17).
retractions.refuted_by: exp14-exp17, 2026-11-09 (prereg/ and the exp14-17 logs in this repository).
patterns: where the three converging\s+results now point
